object_description: large wave-like building volume organized around a central atrium
design_condition: The building occupies nearly the entire plot and expands toward the city, forming a town square, neighbourhood square, hillside garden, and delivery area that mediate between different urban levels and contexts.

positive.statement: The wave-like form creates several urban situations with distinct spatial qualities.

position.rationale: Broad wave-like massing is visible across the footprint and elevations, supporting approximate urban-edge placement.

positive.statement: The underpass connection and access to different levels are handled well at the urban scale.

position.rationale: Access is constrained to the lower building perimeter and ground level; the underpass itself is not distinguishable.

positive.statement: The internal courtyards and central atrium support flexibility, spatial relationships, orientation, and interdisciplinary exchange.

position.rationale: Central void-like organization is identifiable in the top view and supported by the multi-level elevations.

positive.statement: The auditorium and teaching rooms implement the desired flexibility and spatial relationships very well.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are not individually visible, so the placement estimates a plausible mid-level building zone.

positive.statement: The connection between research and teaching is possible horizontally and vertically.

position.rationale: The horizontal and vertical relationship is internal; a distributed mid-building anchor represents it approximately.

positive.statement: The majority of operational processes are efficient and the density of use is appropriate.

position.target: operational processes and density of use
position.rationale: Operational efficiency and use density have no reliable geometric marker in the sampled exterior.

positive.statement: The central atrium is effective across all levels and facilitates orientation.

position.rationale: The central organizing void is the clearest interior-related feature in the top view and spans the elevations.

negative.statement: The overall volume creates a clear jump in scale and introduces a new standard to the district.

position.rationale: The large building volume and its scale are directly evident across all calibrated views.

negative.statement: The building occupies almost the entire property and requires demolition of the existing church.

position.rationale: The sampled building nearly fills the visible footprint; the existing church is not separately represented.

negative.statement: The uniform facade does not respond sufficiently to the differentiated urban situations promised by the form.

position.rationale: Repeated elevation rows show a broadly uniform envelope, though differentiated urban faces are not identifiable.

negative.statement: Some circulation areas are excessively generous and cannot be used convincingly throughout.

position.rationale: Circulation interiors are absent from the point cloud, so a plausible mid-level peripheral zone is used.

negative.statement: Daylight harvesting inside the building may be difficult.

position.rationale: The atrium provides the only plausible daylight-related anchor, while internal daylight paths remain indistinguishable.

negative.statement: The photovoltaic-dominated green terrace creates a conflict on the fifth facade.

position.rationale: A roof-level terrace is constrained by the top footprint, but photovoltaic and planting elements are not separately visible.

negative.statement: The large spans lead to a complex structural system.

position.rationale: Spans are not directly recoverable, so the structural issue is anchored to the broad central mass.

negative.statement: The project ranks poorly in sustainability and economic viability.

position.rationale: Sustainability and economic viability are evaluative judgments without a reliable spatial referent.

negative.statement: The technical access system is somewhat undirected because of the form.

position.rationale: Technical access is internal and indistinguishable; the marker uses a plausible lower peripheral service zone.

negative.statement: The city's interests have to take a back seat in places.

position.rationale: The comment concerns urban integration broadly, so it is distributed over a representative building-site edge.
